{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Verify the number of such orders
n_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Print the result and count
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders: {n_loyal_completed}')"}
